faq.title: Questions, answered plainly
faq.intro: What Assistify does today, where review is required, and what to expect during the closed beta.

questions.question: What is Assistify?
questions.answer: Assistify is a workspace for client relationships, opportunities, projects, tasks, files, business document drafts, and assisted workflows. Its modules share workspace context so related work can stay connected.

questions.question: Is Assistify generally available?
questions.answer: No. Assistify is currently presented as a closed beta. Access and features can change while the product is being tested.

questions.question: Can Copilot make changes on its own?
questions.answer: Copilot prepares supported actions such as creating a client or project and generating project document drafts. Its current action flow shows a preview and asks you to confirm or cancel before execution.

questions.question: How do automations work?
questions.answer: You configure rules from currently supported triggers and actions. Rules can prepare suggestions, wait for approval, or run eligible internal actions depending on their mode. They can be paused, edited, disabled, and reviewed in history.

questions.question: Does Assistify collect invoice payments?
questions.answer: No. Assistify can create invoice records and track their workspace status, but it does not collect payments.

questions.question: Are generated contracts legal advice?
questions.answer: No. Contract output is a draft, not legal advice. You are responsible for reviewing it and obtaining qualified legal advice where needed.

questions.question: How is workspace data separated?
questions.answer: Authenticated requests are scoped to the active workspace or organization. Assistify is designed to prevent one workspace from reading another workspace's records.

questions.question: What security controls are implemented?
questions.answer: Implemented controls include httpOnly authentication cookies, CSRF protection for state-changing requests, workspace-scoped data access, encrypted stored integration tokens, environment-based secrets, AI usage controls, and health monitoring.

questions.question: What do Starter, Pro, and Business cost?
questions.answer: Public prices are not shown while billing is disabled for the closed beta. The plan names describe an intended structure, not currently purchasable subscriptions.

questions.question: Can I use Assistify in Dutch and English?
questions.answer: Yes. The application and these product pages support Dutch and English, although individual user-entered records remain in the language in which they were written.

more.title: Still evaluating the beta?
more.body: Join the beta to explore the current product and share feedback about the workflow your business needs.

seo.title: Security approach
seo.description: Learn about Assistify's implemented cookie, CSRF, workspace isolation, token encryption, secret handling, AI control, and monitoring practices.

security.title: Designed with practical safeguards
security.intro: Assistify applies security controls across authentication, state-changing requests, workspace data, connected-service credentials, AI use, and operational monitoring.

cookies.title: httpOnly authentication cookies
cookies.body: Authentication tokens are held in httpOnly cookies so application JavaScript cannot read them directly.

csrf.title: CSRF protection
csrf.body: State-changing browser requests use a CSRF token header that is checked alongside the authenticated session.

isolation.title: Workspace isolation
isolation.body: Data access is scoped to the authenticated workspace or organization throughout application queries and actions.

tokens.title: Encrypted integration tokens
tokens.body: Stored credentials for connected services are encrypted before they are persisted and decrypted only for supported integration operations.

secrets.title: Secrets in the environment
secrets.body: Application secrets and encryption keys are supplied through the runtime environment instead of being embedded in frontend code.

ai.title: AI usage controls
ai.body: Workspace settings can control AI use, while review and confirmation steps are used for supported generated actions and drafts.

monitoring.title: Health monitoring
monitoring.body: Health endpoints and integration checks provide operational signals for the application and configured connections.

scope.title: A security approach, not a certification claim
scope.body: This page describes implemented product behavior and design choices. It does not claim an external security, privacy, or healthcare certification.
